g.title: EpidemiologicalFeatureTree
g.text: signal: did we infer (from compartments/flows) that gold models use this
infection biology or a causal timeline; arrows only group related booleans.
• Coloured sections = themes (transmission routes, clinical course, ...).
• For one disease we OR-merge gold papers into one canonical profile; SPL checks booleans versus cross-tree logic.

a.xlink:title: Transmission via arthropod / vector compartments or wording (e.g. mosquito).
Partnership sexual network or analogous route cues in flows.
Respiratory aerosol droplet airborne wording or lung-focused flows.
Blood, syringe, maternal-fetal vertical, parental cues.
Hospital ward, HCW, nonspecific institutional contact wording.
Latent, exposed, Eh, incubating, chronic carrier style compartment classes.
Multiple sequential infectious strata or staged chronic progression.
Hospitalized ICU severe mild stratified clinical severity strata.
Treatment ART therapy drug compartments or explicit therapy flows.
Age sex risk group MSM strata demographic roles in compartments.
Patch metropolis multiple regions geographic spatial structuring.

Birth influx immigration recruitment into susceptible explicit naming.
